user.title: Frigate Deep Links
user.description: Connect to Frigate so its event IDs and dashboard deep links become available in Home Assistant. Cameras and tracked object labels are read from your Frigate configuration.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Frigate API. Check the URL and that Frigate is running.
error.invalid_auth: Frigate rejected the username or password.
error.no_cameras: Frigate reported no cameras with tracked objects enabled.

abort.already_configured: This Frigate instance is already configured.

url.name: Build deep link
url.description: Returns a dashboard path that opens a specific Frigate event or review.

event_id.name: Event ID
event_id.description: Frigate event ID, for example from an event entity attribute.

review_id.name: Review ID
review_id.description: Frigate review ID. Used when no event ID is given.

media.name: Media
media.description: Which media the target should open.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: Camera hint so the card can pick the right instance.
